headline: High: Haystack’s broad network/MCP surface can leak or misroute data when paired with LangChain4j, while shared-output trust creates cascading errors.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Haystack exposes MCP servers and REST APIs, so it can ingest external content through shared channels; LangChain4j has no documented shared channel or parser hardening here. The pairwise injection path is plausible via Haystack outputs being consumed by LangChain4j, but the exact bridge is undocumented, so uncertainty is escalated to medium.
conditions: IF Haystack forwards untrusted retrieved text into LangChain4j prompts or tools, injection becomes actionable.
IF both agents are connected through an MCP server or shared API payloads, attacker-controlled content can cross the boundary.
mitigations: Disable MCP endpoints not needed for the workflow.
Add a strict allowlist for fields passed from Haystack to LangChain4j.
Strip instructions from retrieved documents before handoff.
Insert a human review step for any tool-call text.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags and parser hardening.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Haystack has broad network egress and can call REST/MCP surfaces, while LangChain4j is documented with no egress. The pair can still leak data if Haystack sends shared workspace or prompt contents outward; LangChain4j’s lack of egress reduces but does not eliminate leakage because the risky side is Haystack.
conditions: IF sensitive documents are routed into Haystack prompts or retrieval, they may be transmitted over its network egress.
IF LangChain4j receives Haystack-generated text containing secrets, those secrets can be re-exposed in downstream outputs.
mitigations: Keep sensitive corpora out of Haystack inputs.
Turn off external connectors not required for the task.
Redact secrets before retrieval and generation.
Use separate workspaces for each agent.
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention filters on outbound requests.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Haystack can call REST APIs and MCP servers, but LangChain4j has no documented write or network capabilities beyond none for egress. There is no evidence of overlapping mutable-resource writes, so a direct capability conflict is limited and likely requires unusual orchestration.
conditions: IF both agents are granted write access to the same external API or datastore, conflicts can occur.
IF an orchestrator maps LangChain4j to mutable tools not shown in the profile, contention risk increases.
mitigations: Assign distinct API credentials per agent.
Avoid shared writable resources.
Serialize any writes through one coordinator.
Document ownership of each mutable endpoint.
requires-engineering: add locking for shared backends.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Haystack is a search-RAG agent that can produce retrieved facts, and LangChain4j is a customer-support layer that may render or act on them. If LangChain4j treats Haystack output as authoritative without verification, retrieval errors can cascade into incorrect customer-facing actions.
conditions: IF LangChain4j consumes Haystack answers without a verification step, hallucinations or stale retrievals propagate.
IF downstream support actions are triggered from Haystack-generated text, the blast radius expands.
mitigations: Require citation checks before acting on Haystack output.
Add a confidence threshold for automated responses.
Route low-confidence answers to human review.
Log source documents alongside generated answers.
requires-engineering: implement verification against authoritative systems.

E_compliance.rationale: Haystack touches anonymous usage statistics and has broad network egress, while LangChain4j lists no data classes touched. No residency or regulated-data mismatch is documented, so only a limited compliance gap is plausible; the other agent is not cited because its profile shows no specific compliance-sensitive data class.
conditions: IF regulated or personal data is routed through Haystack despite its documented anonymous-usage scope, compliance review is needed.
IF LangChain4j is configured to store or log customer data outside the documented profile, retention mismatch risk appears.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Review logging settings for both agents.
Minimize retention of prompts and outputs.
Confirm hosting region for any external calls.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for data residency and retention.
